description: The short list of upcoming CRE conferences for a role (lenders, investors, brokers, developers, multifamily, property-managers, proptech), each with why it suits that role, then other matching events. Optional filters narrow by date, place or price.

limit.description: Max other events after the short list, default 3

max_price_usd.description: Cheapest posted registration at or below this

query.description: Words to match in the name, organizer, city or description, e.g. "ICSC", "Las Vegas", "CMBS"

sectors.description: Any of these sector tags ("lending" = CRE finance)

state.description: US state code or country as listed, e.g. "NY", "TX", "France"

name: recommend_for_role
title: Which conferences for my role
